summary: This Form 8-K reports that CERO THERAPEUTICS HOLDINGS, INC. entered into an amended and restated promissory note with SRX Health Solutions, Inc., increasing aggregate borrowing capacity to $1,413,600 (total funded: $1,413,600), with a 10% interest rate, maturing May 28, 2027. The note is convertible into common stock at a price equal to the lesser of $0.05 or 80% of the average of the five lowest intraday prices in the prior 20 days (subject to a 4.99% beneficial ownership limitation). The company is required to file a resale registration statement. This is a routine financing arrangement—not a special situation. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or regulatory clock is implicated. Watch for dilution from potential conversions and share price volatility.
